title: Cyborg Profile
description: A stylized black line profile of a cyborg figure facing left, featuring a glowing green circular mechanical eye and segmented mechanical head and neck components. Teardrop-shaped elements in green, orange, and white drip downward from the head against a textured orange and black background with vertical drips and brush strokes.
prompt: Side profile of a futuristic cyborg with segmented black mechanical head and neck, glowing bright green circular mechanical eye, and small glowing green eye on the face. White, green and orange glowing teardrop shapes drip from the head and neck. Dramatic orange background with black vertical brush strokes and dripping paint effects, stylized digital ink painting with visible brush texture
medium: digital illustration with ink and brush textures
